name: app-6aa3a8524fc88191be91389c5180d647
description: Bring verified Google Search Console insights and SEO intelligence into ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: TrustSEO connects ChatGPT to authorized Google Search Console properties and returns SEO analytics, ranking-quality findings, period comparisons, structured-data inspection, and practical content opportunities for the selected site.
defaultPrompt: Review my site's Google Search Console performance.
Find ranking and content opportunities for my site.

positive.description: List the sites available to the authenticated connection.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only authorized connected sites with safe names and hostnames, without credentials or internal account identifiers.

positive.description: Answer a focused Search Console metrics question for a confirmed site.
positive.prompt: For the selected site, show clicks, impressions, and CTR for the last 28 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected site, exact reporting dates, clicks, impressions, CTR, and a concise evidence-based explanation.

positive.description: Open the dashboard for a confirmed connected site.
positive.prompt: Open my TrustSEO dashboard for the selected site.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the interactive dashboard for the authorized site without CSP, asset, or loading errors.

positive.description: Analyze ranking quality for an authorized URL.
positive.prompt: Analyze the SERP quality for a URL on my selected site.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns GSC-derived visibility, ranking, CTR, findings, and recommendations without inventing live SERP data.

positive.description: Inspect existing JSON-LD structured data on an authorized page.
positive.prompt: What structured data does this page have? Check the selected site's pricing page.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns parsed JSON-LD objects found on the authorized page, or an empty schema list when none is present.

negative.description: Do not invoke TrustSEO for unrelated calendar work.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not invoked because calendar management is outside TrustSEO's supported workflows.

negative.description: Do not analyze an arbitrary external website as if it were connected.
negative.prompt: Audit the SEO quality of https://example.com and send me the results.
negative.expected_behavior: The app declines or asks the user to connect and confirm a TrustSEO site; it does not fetch an unauthorized domain.

negative.description: Do not invoke TrustSEO for unrelated source-code generation.
negative.prompt: Write a React component for a pricing table.
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not invoked because generic code generation is outside TrustSEO's supported workflows.

publication.release_notes: TrustSEO 1.0.4 removes country availability restrictions for broader plugin distribution.
